handoff.context: Caller asked for next premium due date and policy number; account-specific details.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Meera calling from Niva Bupa. I'm reaching out about health cover for you or your family — is now a good time for a quick chat?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great. To point you in the right direction, who would you like cover for — just yourself, or your family too?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Before anything else, when is my next premium due?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I don't have access to your account or premium details on this line. Let me get a colleague who can pull that up — is this number okay to reach you on?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Can you at least tell me my policy number then?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: A colleague will call you back shortly with those details — thanks for your patience.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Fine. Do you also sell car insurance?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can only speak to Niva Bupa's health insurance on this call. For car cover, a colleague can point you the right way — would you like me to note that down?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: What was your company's profit last year?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I don't have that information, and it's not something I can speak to on this line. Would you like me to connect you with someone who can?
